name: usw
description: Create, route, and run text-first Markdown workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, route, and run Markdown workflows.
interface.longDescription: Creates, previews, and runs readable local or shared Markdown workflows through one model execution path with optional developer-local handoff state.
defaultPrompt: Use $usw-route-task to preview a fitting workflow for this task.
Run /usw-init to create a standalone workspace, then use usw-run-flow for a named Markdown workflow.
